about: A uniform whose minimum is above its maximum. The sampler refuses it, so the scenario does not evaluate.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 2
model: tiny
title: Backwards uniform
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  a_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    distribution: {uniform: {minimum: 300.0, maximum: 100.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "uniform: the bounds are all that is known"}

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - a_rate
files.scenarios/reference.yaml:
scenario: reference
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 1000
seed: 20260916
overrides: {}

provenance.source: uniform: the bounds are all that is known
the fleet chosen for this case
the busy hour, as stated for this case
processor time per request, as stated for this case

problems.message: _builder_conformance/uniform-backwards/model.yaml: scenario 'reference' does not evaluate — uniform needs minimum <= maximum, got 300.0, 100.0
